name: TOMG-Bench v1 — wAcc
protocol: Original TOMG-Bench v1 fixed 45,000-example test set and official weighted average accuracy; unweighted and S2 revisions excluded.

explanation.en: Official wAcc combines task correctness with novelty or molecular-similarity weighting over the fixed test set.
explanation.zh: 官方 wAcc 在固定测试集上结合任务正确性与新颖性或分子相似度权重。

summary.en: TOMG-Bench evaluates open-domain text-guided molecule generation, editing, and optimization.
summary.zh: TOMG-Bench 评估开放式文本引导的分子生成、编辑和优化。

task_format.en: Generate molecular structures satisfying natural-language requirements across nine fixed subtasks.
task_format.zh: 在九个固定子任务中生成满足自然语言要求的分子结构。
